title: senecio squalidus subsp. rupestris
intro: Senecio squalidus subsp. rupestris, commonly known as the Greek mountain gromwell, is a plant species within the Senecio genus, native to the mountainous regions of Greece. The Greek mountain gromwell is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and alkaloids, which may contribute to its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant.
